patch.value: Fixed: a merge whose merged tree carries diff3 conflict markers no longer commits. It now returns kind 'conflicted', writes the merged tree to the working tree and index so the markers and clean paths are visible, and persists in-progress merge state (parents, bases, message, author, conflicted paths) under the control directory. status reports clean=false and names the conflicted paths via a durable merge field. commit, switch, reset, undo, and a second merge all refuse while the state exists. merge --continue builds the merge commit from the resolved index and refuses while any staged blob still carries markers; merge --abort restores the working tree and clears the state. --fail-on-conflict now fires without having committed. Verified: full release:check passes (100/100/100/100 coverage); all three defect regression tests fail against the reverted source and pass with the fix; the eight new-behavior refusal tests fail when their guards are removed.
